race.comment: PROFLIGATE (5) resumed with an eye-catching fourth in the Atlantic Jewel Stakes, getting back and running on strongly behind impressive winner Pretty Baby. Loved her last 100m there and she draws better here. No doubt she'll get over further but with the added fitness she should go close. PORTINARI (6) beat PROFLIGATE home in the Atlantic Jewel, setting close to the pace and battling on well for third. Tough draw but was well backed there and with a good Blake Shinn ride she'll take beating. TOLAGA BAY (8) is undefeated in two starts, albeit she was a touch lucky given the runner-up last time was something licked. Still, she should improve again and can measure up. SAINTLY DANCER (10) was solid in the Atlantic Jewel and maps for every chance. ICELADY (9) chased Over Excited first up and that form was franked last week, consider.
